How to use this book

IMPULSE LEARNING CENTER

What each column shows

WORDSThe word or phrase with its part of speech in blue italics.
TRANSCRIPTIONHow to say the word (British English IPA). ˈ shows the main stress.
DEFINITIONA short, simple meaning in English.
EXAMPLEThe word in a real sentence from the unit — the word is in bold blue.
RUSSIAN · UZBEKTranslations to check your understanding.

Abbreviations

nnounn plplural nounvverb phr vphrasal verbadjadjectiveadvadverb prepprepositionconjconjunctionpronpronoun detdeterminerphrphraseexclexclamation

Study tips

  • Learn 10–15 words a day. Cover the definition and say the meaning.
  • Read the transcription aloud and copy the stress.
  • Write your own example sentence for every new word.
  • Cover the English column and translate back from Russian or Uzbek.
  • Review each unit again after 1 day, 1 week and 1 month.
